Mod.Name: Sand
Mod.Author: wizz6rd
Mod.Description:
Granular media for Besiege: sand, wet sand, dust, snow, gravel, mud and glue, as a level-wide simulation that machines can drive on, dig, plough, scoop and be buried by, and that explosions throw about. Sand at rest is kept as a height field in layers, so a level can hold a great deal of it; only sand that is moving, or that something is touching, is simulated as grains.
Adds the Media Sprayer block. Pick a medium and it presets its rate, speed and spread; every number stays editable afterwards. The medium leaves through the crate's open face. Also adds sand regions (a box, a cylinder, a ball) to the level editor, and a panel with a brush for painting and removing sand.
Press F9 in any scene for a report of the machine and of what the sand is doing.
